Question: Kamala Harris could not get support of 1% of Democrats in 2020. What has she achieved in the four years since to be their current flavour of the month.? Is she the best Democrats have to offer for a Presidential candidate?
Answer: Is she the best Democrats have to offer? Probably not. But she’s better than what Republicans have to offer, and that’s all that matters. Once again, thanks to how bad the Republican nominee is, the concern in this election is not about finding the best person for the job, but finding the person who is best able to defeat the worst person for the job. It’s situational politics, to use a baseball analogy. In baseball, sometimes the best pitchers struggle against one or two batters who are generally mediocre. Or sometimes you have a batter who is really good at drawing a walk, bunting, or making sacrifice flies but who isn’t your best hitter for average or power. If it’s the bottom of the ninth and you’re in a tight game and need to get a runner into scoring position, you might take out a power hitter to put in a better bunter. If you have a runner on third, you may take out the guy with the best batting average on your team to put in the guy who can hit a long sac fly that will drive the runner home. Biden is arguably a better President than what we might expect from Harris. He’s set records for job creation, deficit cuts, GDP growth, and more. Historians are already ranking him as the 14th best President in American history. But if he can’t drive in the winning run right now, the country needed the Democrats to pick someone who could. Harris may not be the best Presidential candidate the Democrats have, but she has what is needed to beat the orange fascist, and the Democrats have to win this election or this country is doomed. So we’ll take the long sac fly for the win instead of leaving in the MVP and risking a loss.
